scripts.db:generate: npm run db:stamp && dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma generate
scripts.db:push: npm run db:stamp && dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma db push && npm run db:backfill
scripts.db:push:reset: npm run db:stamp && dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma db push --force-reset --accept-data-loss && npm run db:backfill
scripts.db:migrate:new: cross-env DATABASE_PROVIDER=postgresql node scripts/stamp-schema.mjs && dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: npm run db:stamp && dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:generate && dotenv -e ../../.env -- tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:stamp && dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma db push --force-reset --accept-data-loss && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:studio: npm run db:stamp && dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma studio
